title: On the structure of certain valued fields II
summary: We study the structure of finitely ramified henselian valued fields of mixed characteristic with arbitrary residue fields via their residue rings of higher length, where a residue ring of length $n$ is the quotient ring of the valuation ring by the $n$th power of its maximal ideal. We prove an approximate lifting theorem for homomorphisms between residue rings of higher length and explicitly determine the optimal bound of error of lifting. As applications, we obtain several Ax-Kochen-Ershov principles for relative completeness, relative existential completeness, and existential closedness…
